executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json,re,hashlib
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'reports/research/510300_bank_excess_reserve_buffer_source_qualification_v1'
def rj(p): return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save(n,o):
    p=out/n
    if p.exists(): raise RuntimeError('保留旧原件，不覆盖：'+n)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
now=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
old=rj(out/'全部本地原报告_超额准备金全部原锚.json')
matrix=[]
allanchors=[]
for t0 in old['target_quarters_29_complete']+[old['prior_definition_anchor_2018Q2_separate']]:
    t={k:v for k,v in t0.items() if k!='target_hits'}
    if 'text_cache' not in t:
        t['literal_target_mentions']=[]
        t['current_quarter_numeric_candidates']=[]
        t['interpretation_contexts']=[]
        matrix.append(t)
        continue
    p=root/t['text_cache']['path']
    b=p.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()!=t['text_cache']['sha256']: raise RuntimeError('全文缓存改变：'+t['quarter'])
    pages=json.loads(b.decode('utf-8-sig'))
    anchors=[]
    candidates=[]
    causecontexts=[]
    q=t['quarter']
    months={'1':'3月末','2':'6月末','3':'9月末','4':q[:4]+'年末'}
    expected=months[q[-1]]
    for item in pages:
        page=item.get('pdf_page_1based',item.get('pdf_page'))
        body=re.sub(r'\s+','',item['text']).replace('％','%')
        for m in re.finditer(r'超额(?:存款)?准备金(?:率|利率)?|超储率',body):
            context=body[max(0,m.start()-220):m.end()+300]
            anchors.append({'quarter':q,'pdf_page_1based':page,'original_literal':m.group(0),'context_without_layout_whitespace':context})
        for m in re.finditer(r'(?:金融机构|银行业金融机构|商业银行)(?:的|平均|人民币|超额|存款|准备金|率|总体)*?超额(?:存款)?准备金率(?:平均)?(?:为|是)?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%',body):
            prefix=body[max(0,m.start()-90):m.start()]
            context=body[max(0,m.start()-110):m.end()+140]
            if expected in prefix or (q[-1]=='4' and ('12月末' in prefix or (q[:4]+'年末') in prefix)):
                candidates.append({'quarter':q,'pdf_page_1based':page,'current_quarter_end_literal':expected,'full_original_named_ratio':m.group(0),'rate_percent':float(m.group(1)),'context':context,'quarter_end_original_statistic':'CURRENT_QUARTER_END_EXPLICIT','historical_release_clock_admitted':False,'first_vintage':'NOT_CERTIFIED','numerator_current_series_definition':'UNKNOWN','denominator_current_series_definition':'UNKNOWN'})
        for m in re.finditer(r'超额(?:存款)?准备金|超储率|货币乘数|风险偏好|信贷需求|银行.{0,15}(?:动力|意愿)|基础货币.{0,30}货币',body):
            start=max(0,m.start()-140); end=min(len(body),m.end()+400)
            context=body[start:end]
            if ('准备金' in context and any(x in context for x in ['基础货币','贷款','支付清算','比例','一般存款','资产扩张','财政','风险'])) or ('信贷需求' in context) or ('风险偏好' in context):
                causecontexts.append({'quarter':q,'pdf_page_1based':page,'context':context,'meaning':'原当前载体历史机制/约束原锚，尚非可知钟或严格因果识别'})
    t['literal_target_mentions']=anchors
    t['current_quarter_numeric_candidates']=candidates
    t['interpretation_contexts']=causecontexts
    t['literal_extraction_repair']='原经济对象不变，补入原文字面超额存款准备金及原平均限定；原初次错误提取保持'
    matrix.append(t)
    allanchors.extend(anchors)
targets=matrix[:29]
nqualified=sum(len(t['current_quarter_numeric_candidates'])==1 for t in targets)
save('全部29季度_修正字面名称后的原字段矩阵.json',{'study_id':old['study_id'],'completed_at':now,'targets':targets,'prior_2018Q2_definition_separate':matrix[-1],'complete_target_members':29,
    'local_current_original_carriers':19,'current_quarter_named_numeric_field_uniquely_found':nqualified,
    'missing_current_carrier_quarters':[t['quarter'] for t in targets if 'text_cache' not in t],
    'local_current_field_missing_or_ambiguous':[{'quarter':t['quarter'],'candidate_count':len(t['current_quarter_numeric_candidates'])} for t in targets if 'text_cache' in t and len(t['current_quarter_numeric_candidates'])!=1],
    'all_original_target_word_mentions':allanchors,'historical_numeric_to_release_clock_admitted_quarters':0,
    'minimum_full_source_gate_passed':False,'same_carrier_later_version_failure_preserved':True,
    'definition_warning':'当前报告命名原比率不自动认证一般存款分母、同母体方法、备用资金余额或变化因果。',
    'new_equity_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_network_queries':0,'new_GETs':0,'source_code_edits':0})
save('官方限定检索回执_四次已用完.json',{'study_id':old['study_id'],'completed_at':now,'query_budget':4,'queries_used':4,'queries':[
 {'q':'site:pbc.gov.cn "2025年第三季度" "超额准备金率"','returned_results':0},
 {'q':'site:pbc.gov.cn "超额准备金率" "准备金存款" "各项存款"','returned_results':0},
 {'q':'site:pbc.gov.cn "2019年第三季度" "平均超额准备金率"','returned_results':0},
 {'q':'site:pbc.gov.cn "超额存款准备金率"','result_objects_found':[
  {'url':'https://www.pbc.gov.cn/goutongjiaoliu/113456/113469/3360428/2017081120382279077.pdf','use':'2017Q2一般存款分母及机制定义候选；非29当前季度、不能填原29值或修复历史版本'},
  {'url':'https://wuhan.pbc.gov.cn/eportal/fileDir/history_file/files/att_11632_1.pdf','use':'较早报告超额比率定义候选；非当前季度'},
  {'url':'https://www.pbc.gov.cn/zhengcehuobisi/125207/125227/125957/4021036/c4d5506cdc934984b4507cce3a9d6ae4/2020080617373334147.pdf','use':'2020Q2真实原链接出现，不等于公布页/版本已合格'}
 ]}],
 'boundary':'搜索命中/搜索月份标签不是原公开时点。前三空结果不证明原字段/报告不存在；第四已补命名发现。没有新增报告下载，不扩查询，不猜地址；不读取旧E17关闭端点。',
 'authenticated_requests':0,'new_original_report_GETs':0,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0})
print('全部29季度保留；当前已有载体19；唯一当前季度命名原数值',nqualified)
for t in targets:
 print(t['quarter'],'候选',len(t['current_quarter_numeric_candidates']),[{'原名':x['full_original_named_ratio'],'百分数':x['rate_percent'],'原页':x['pdf_page_1based']} for x in t['current_quarter_numeric_candidates']])
print('四次官方检索预算已用完；当前值与历史钟准入0，模型/股票标签/账户均0')
